categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and fixes transaction origin privacy during peer relay.
categories.rationale: Resubmitting evicted unconfirmed transactions undermines the origin privacy expected by users running with `-privatebroadcast`. As noted in the PR, re-adding dropped transactions leaves them held uniquely by the node and served to any peer asking, which 'marks it as the node's own'.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Disables wallet resubmission behavior that would otherwise compromise user privacy under `-privatebroadcast`. Preventing the wallet from periodically re-injecting unconfirmed or dust transactions into the local mempool avoids unintended clearnet exposure.
